ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PetSolea uses your location only while you use the app to show nearby veterinarians and pet stores.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PetSolea accesses your photos so you can choose a profile photo or veterinary document.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PetSolea uses the camera to scan vaccination cards and veterinary documents.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PetSolea accesses the microphone only with your explicit consent to record and transcribe a veterinary visit.
